snippet.title: Puzzle Compound - Final Trailer
snippet.description:
The final trailer for Puzzle Compound, an online cooperative multiplayer puzzle solving game where 2-4 friends gather clues, work together and explore multiple locations with the goal of escaping. 

Coming to Steam, the Epic Games Store, and Itch.io May 25th! Wishlist today!

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1611290/Puzzle_Compound/
Epic: https://store.epicgames.com/en-US/p/puzzle-compound-fe9903
Itch: https://noblephantomgames.itch.io/puzzle-compound

[Credits]
Music by Dyalla

#indiegame #unrealengine #gametrailers #gaming #indiedev #unrealengine4
